_about: Data for the daar station v2 (design system §13), the combined station js/cook/stations/daar.js: v3 (29 Sept play-test, D1): the swipe chop again (chop's own game since Sprint 18: js/cook/stations/chop.js Cook.Chop.play on data/stations/chop.json, its own levels, decoys and timer), the pieces waiting at the side, then the tadka in the pot on the kitchen kit's hob (one burner, one pot: the knob, the spices in the order Nani says, the chopped vegetables, the daar) and stir as many times as Nani says. Serve and taste (§14a). mechanic.levels (merged in order): vegDecoys / spiceDecoys (extra crates and jars on the shelf), spiceShelf (where the spice decoys come from), ladder (how Nana's card shows the tadka order in the cook: words, or closed = the card starts folded to face + headline and a peek costs a hint, §14a; no dots or hidden rows: no pips, and a hidden section would let the card fold with its check early), (v3, S16: no oil-heating ring; the oil is hot at once and the sizzle says so. The stir's speed dial reads data.mechanics.stir's bands.) `phases`: one English line per job (placeholders, like every station goal).
_band: SH-248 (Zafar, 10 Nov): this game's bottom row, read by St.stoneBand(S, {game}); "tray" for top-down things, "shelf" for side-on (docs/game-design/modes/cook-bottom-row.md)

askLines._about: Sprint 19 (Fable's daar flaw 2; non-negotiable 2): Nani's stir line is one sentence the engine can't say yet (it stitched 'Firai! Trae! aste thi' from three recordings). Until Mum records it, her box shows its English as the grey-italic placeholder (js/cook/words.js Lang.toRecord), filled with the laps' and the speed's own English; logged in docs/language/recording-sheet.md (daar-stir-ask).

station.name: Daar
station.goal: Swipe to chop what Nani says, add the spices in the order she says, then stir as many times as she says.

phases.chop: Swipe to chop what Nani says, before the timer runs out.
phases.cook: Turn on the hob, add the spices in the order Nani says, then the chopped vegetables and the daar.

scene._about: Sprint 18 (wave 2, STD-F2-03: a game's own numbers in its settings file): where daar's things stand, in design px on the 1600x900 grid (js/cook/stations/daar.js reads them as SC()). side: where the chopped pieces wait, counter while chopping (one row per vegetable, right to left from x), cook beside the hob (centred on x); pile: one piece's heap; chopTimer: chop's ring on the board; plainBowl: the plain daar on its trivet, waiting to pour (w: its round body); dial: the stir's speed dial's centre; serveBowl: the served bowl (w: its picture's width) and the review face over it; pop: the word pop's place from the pot's right rim (dx) and its centre (dy); pourMs: the daar's pour, each phase (the shared pour, SH-117).
scene._s19: S19 (Fable's daar flaws 8, 9 and 10): katori, the empty steel katori (t-steel-serving-bowl) waiting from the cook phase's first frame with the asker's face on its rim, where the daar is served (serveBowl: the same place, its steel bowl the katori's size, 0.78 of the picture); glass: each chopped heap's small glass bowl (d) and their pitch in a row, the rows 140 apart so a row's light never covers the next (DAAR-43); the dial raised to y 300 so the katori sits clear under it.

_items: S19 wave A (ART-69, SH-243; the art run's F4): the tadka's things as cream bowls seen from above, on the stone tray with their pills (js/cook/stations/daar.js shelf); card: the item card's picture too (js/cook/ui.js cardPic: a game's own card first), so the card shows what the child taps; file (garlic, green chilli): the tray's picture only, their cards stay one of the thing (SH-242: the chop's card is one chilli)
_assets: S19 (decision 68, loadcheck): the pictures daar loads beyond data/cook.json art.assets.stations.daar: the chopped heaps' glass bowls and the serving katori; S19 wave A: the eight cream bowls on the stone tray (v4/daar) and the kit's ladle (v4/kit/ladle)

levels._spiceShelf: S14 roll-out (DAAR-36): an eighth jar, elchi, so L4 has room for its four spices and four decoys (the central rules)
levels.stirLine: Stir round the pot as many times as Nani says, then tap the tick.
